visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of thin slices of lotus root tossed in a reddish sauce. A hand holding dark wooden chopsticks carefully places a fresh green cilantro sprig onto the pile. The scene is set in a bright, warmly lit kitchen with a blurred wooden surface in the background. (2) A large, peeled, pale yellow lotus root lies on a thick wooden cutting board. A hand holds the root steady while another hand slices it into very thin, uniform rounds using a stainless steel chef's knife. (3) The hand places the freshly cut lotus root slices into a clear glass bowl filled with water to soak. The background remains the same kitchen setting. (4) A top-down view shows a red pot filled with boiling water, releasing clouds of steam. A hand sprinkles white salt into the bubbles and then adds the lotus root slices. (5) The slices are scooped out of the pot and placed into another clear bowl filled with ice water to cool rapidly. (6) A glass bowl is shown while dark brown soy sauce is poured in from a bottle. Successive shots show a hand adding salt, white vinegar, clear liquid, sesame oil, minced garlic, chopped red chilies, and white sesame seeds. (7) The blanched lotus root slices are added to the bowl containing the mixed sauce. A hand uses a black spatula to thoroughly coat each slice in the dark, spicy glaze. (8) The finished lotus root slices are plated on a small dish atop a bamboo mat, presented under bright, appetizing studio-style lighting.

(5) [Subtitle]: 加入少許鹽巴進 汆燙用的水. (6) [Subtitle]: 將蓮藕汆燙至 半透明狀態即可. (7) [Subtitle]: 馬上將汆燙好的 蓮藕泡入冰水中. (8) [Subtitle]: 醬汁 醬油 2大匙 鹽 適量 白醋 適量 味醂 2大匙 香油 少許 蒜碎 10g 辣椒碎 5g 熟白芝麻 1湯匙.
